integrity: Elementary published parity lemma plus independently written Hoeffding and leading-length argument; executable spot checks do not prove all-parameter theorem.
scientific_limitations: Zero lower density only, no proof that natural density exists, no upper-density estimate at all scales. Later journal version is background and not the first-public date. Unindexed duplicate risk persists.
title: Zero lower density for ternary elated numbers with an exponentially sparse-scale bound
